value.expr: "Multiplying by $\omega^{\val{k}}$ turns the plane by $\val{k}/\val{n}$ of a turn."

ast.v: Multiplying by $\omega^{\val{0}}$ turns the plane by $\val{1}/\val{2}$ of a turn.

value.text: Every root lies on the unit circle, $\lvert\omega\rvert = 1$.

After $n$ steps you are back at $1$,
so $\omega^n = 1$ for every root.

why.text: That is $\omega^{n/2}$, and only when $n$ is even.

text.text: Each root is a turn of $1/n$.

*[figure]*
